title: Riquewihr Christmas Market Day Walk (2025)
youtubeTitle: Riquewihr, France Christmas Market | Inside the Shops, Cellars & Courtyards | 4K 🎄
heroAlt: The Dolder and decorated half-timbered houses on my Riquewihr Christmas walk
description: I spent two hours ducking into shops, wine cellars and courtyards in Riquewihr. I climb the main street to the Dolder, step inside its museum, follow the quieter lanes along the walls and finish at the Christmas market beside the town hall.

photo.alt: The decorated Hôtel de Ville arch at the start of my Riquewihr walk

chapters.description: I begin outside the town hall at 12:55 PM, then pass through the arch into the old town.
